noteNone: No open tasks from the last meeting.
noteNoMeeting: No earlier meeting yet. Test meetings don't count.
noteTooOld: The latest minutes are from {date} — too old to bring tasks from.
noteImport: No open tasks in the minutes from {date}.
noteMeeting: No open tasks from the meeting on {date}. Test meetings don't count.
fromMeeting: Open tasks from the meeting on {date}.
fromImport: Open tasks from the minutes of {date} (imported).
fromLast: Open tasks from the last meeting.
title: Prepare meeting
failedTitle: The agenda couldn't be put together
loading: Simon Says is reading the last meeting and putting together the agenda …
heldTitle: The meeting has already been held
heldText: The agenda for {date} has already been used. Choose another date for the next meeting.
editingText: Simon Says only changes its own lines in the document. What anyone has written or changed there stays.
agendaHint: Simon Says has filled in what we know. Add what only you know — a party at the university, a visit, a question someone wants to raise.
updatedInPlace: The document is updated where it is.
createNote: Simon Says creates the document in the association's meeting folder (or in your Drive if you haven't opened the folder) and shares it with the members. You can keep writing in it as usual.
doneText: When you press Start meeting {when}Simon Says suggests this agenda right away. During the meeting the notes are written under the right item, and what's done from last week is ticked off.
kept: Someone has written in the document, so the order there is kept as it was. New items have been added.
retryLater: Try again in a little while.
offline: We couldn't reach the server. Check the network and try again.
